text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 9: Embedded solar capacity has grown 7% to 16% a year at the four Primary substations with 6 or more season-years'
text.tspan: Figure 9: Embedded solar capacity has grown 7% to 16% a year at the four
Primary substations with 6 or more season-years

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Capacity C per season-year, with the 95% interval from 200 resamples of seven-day blocks of days. Hollow dot: the test misses a day-long load of a quarter of the capacity and flags half the capacity in under 80% of resamples. Dashed line: a straight line fitted to the logarithm of C, which is constant percentage growth. Text in each panel: fitted growth per year, with the 95% interval from resampling the season-years. Six or seven points per line: the interval is wide and the line is a summary, not a forecast. Kirton (no capacity given) and Wrangle T1 (too small) are not shown.'
text.tspan: Capacity C per season-year, with the 95% interval from 200 resamples of seven-day blocks of days. Hollow dot: the
test misses a day-long load of a quarter of the capacity and flags half the capacity in under 80% of resamples.
Dashed line: a straight line fitted to the logarithm of C, which is constant percentage growth.
Text in each panel: fitted growth per year, with the 95% interval from resampling the season-years. Six or seven
points per line: the interval is wide and the line is a summary, not a forecast. Kirton (no capacity given) and
Wrangle T1 (too small) are not shown.
